boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-admission places and scheduled activities on or near UAB for an under-21-friendly outing.

cards.title: UAB Campus Green
cards.subtitle: UAB campus, 9th Ave S
cards.notes: Bring a blanket or a classmate and use the open lawn during a listed free Campus Green activity; check the calendar before heading over.
cards.short_summary: An open campus lawn with free scheduled community activities.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB describes Campus Green as open space for the university community and guests, and its calendar lists free activities there.
cards.access_notes: Use the calendar listing to confirm a free activity and any event-specific requirements.

cards.entity_name: Abroms-Engel Institute for the Visual Arts
cards.title: Browse AEIVA exhibitions
cards.subtitle: 1221 10th Ave S, UAB campus
cards.notes: Walk through the contemporary exhibitions together during public hours, then use the displayed work as a prompt for an unhurried conversation.
cards.short_summary: UAB’s contemporary-art center offers rotating public exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: AEIVA states that its exhibitions and programs are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Visit | Abroms-Engel Institute for the Visual Arts
cards.access_notes: Public hours are Tuesday–Saturday, noon–5 p.m.; exhibitions rotate, so check what is on view.

cards.title: See student work at Gallery 501
cards.subtitle: 501 Building, 501 12th St S
cards.notes: Stop in during staffed hours to look at work by UAB art students and invited artists; pair it with a walk through the nearby arts campus.
cards.short_summary: A small UAB gallery centered on student and guest-artist exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB states that Gallery 501 exhibitions and programs are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Gallery 501 | UAB Department of Art and Art History
cards.access_notes: Staffed Monday and Wednesday 2:30–5 p.m. and Friday 2–5 p.m.; appointments are also available.

cards.entity_name: Dennis G. Pappas Historical Collections Gallery
cards.title: Explore the Pappas Gallery
cards.subtitle: Lister Hill Library, 1700 University Blvd
cards.notes: Use the rotating historical displays for a low-key visit, and ask a museum guide for highlights if your group has five or fewer people.
cards.short_summary: A free UAB historical-collections gallery inside Lister Hill Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UAB Libraries says the Pappas Gallery is always free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Visit Us | Dennis G. Pappas Historical Collections Gallery
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Saturday, noon–5 p.m. Non-UAB visitors use the video intercom for library access.

cards.title: Wander the Birmingham Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: 2000 Reverend Abraham Woods Jr Blvd
cards.notes: Meet in the collection galleries and pick one artwork each to discuss; general admission covers the galleries and most exhibitions.
cards.short_summary: A downtown art museum with free general admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The Birmingham Museum of Art states that general admission is free every day and includes collection galleries and most exhibitions.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Birmingham Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Check the museum page for current hours and any exception for a particular exhibition or closure.

cards.title: Take a Railroad Park loop
cards.subtitle: 1600 1st Ave S, downtown Birmingham
cards.notes: Walk the paths, use the rail trail, or bring your own picnic and settle near the lawns; keep the plan simple and purchase-free.
cards.short_summary: A 19-acre downtown greenspace with paths and open gathering areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Railroad Park states that it is free to the public and open daily.
cards.access_notes: The park lists daily hours of 7 a.m.–11 p.m.; separately priced food or events are optional.

cards.title: Stroll Birmingham Botanical Gardens
cards.subtitle: 2612 Lane Park Rd, Birmingham
cards.notes: Choose a garden section, follow the paths at your own pace, and bring water instead of planning around the café or gift shop.
cards.short_summary: A public garden with walking paths, water features, and free entry.
cards.evidence_claim: Birmingham Botanical Gardens states that general admission is free and the gardens are open to the public every day.
cards.access_notes: Garden grounds are open daily; the official visit page also states parking is free.

cards.title: Hike Red Mountain Park
cards.subtitle: 2011 Frankfurt Dr, Birmingham
cards.notes: Pick a marked trail or overlook, stay on the designated route, and check conditions before leaving; no admission or parking payment is required.
cards.short_summary: A large Birmingham park with trails, overlooks, and mining-history landscape.
cards.evidence_claim: Jefferson County Greenways states that Red Mountain Park has no parking or admission fee.
cards.source_title: Red Mountain Park | Jefferson County Greenways
cards.access_notes: Listed daily hours are 7 a.m.–7 p.m.; use the official trail map and observe posted closures.

cards.title: Visit the Civil Rights National Monument
cards.subtitle: A.G. Gaston Motel area, 1510 5th Ave N
cards.notes: Use the monument’s visitor information to orient your walk through the district and reflect on Birmingham’s civil-rights history together.
cards.short_summary: A National Park Service site interpreting Birmingham’s civil-rights history.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Park Service states that Birmingham Civil Rights National Monument is fee-free year-round and requires no entrance fee or pass.
cards.source_title: Basic Information - Birmingham Civil Rights National Monument
cards.access_notes: The NPS notes that the 1954 wing of the A.G. Gaston Motel is temporarily closed for renovations; use current visitor information.

cards.title: Walk Kelly Ingram Park
cards.subtitle: 5th Ave N & 16th St, Civil Rights District
cards.notes: Follow the short walking trail and pause at the civil-rights monuments; treat the space as a reflective outdoor visit rather than a rushed photo stop.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor civil-rights memorial park with monuments and a short trail.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Park Service lists Kelly Ingram Park as an outdoor green space with civil-rights monuments and a short walking trail; the monument site is fee-free.
cards.source_title: Operating Hours & Seasons - Birmingham Civil Rights National Monument
cards.access_notes: NPS lists the park as open daily from 8 a.m.–8 p.m.; it is an outdoor space, so plan for weather.
